name: Starlight Mining Company
detailed_description:
Shape the Battlefield

Break through rock formations to carve your own mining routes and defensive chokepoints. Every planet is a puzzle: plan your base layout to control enemy movement and protect your starlight drill. Choose where to build walls, place turrets, and establish power grids as you adapt to the planet’s terrain.

Hold the Line

Face waves of increasingly dangerous enemies each night. Build powerful turrets, reinforce your defenses, and deploy specialized support structures to survive the onslaught. Boss fights bring unique challenges that test your team’s coordination and your base’s durability.

Invest, Upgrade, Adapt

Every successful mission rewards starlight. Spend it on permanent ship upgrades, mastering abilities, and stronger equipment to take on more dangerous planets. No two planets are the same, so adapt your strategy, pick the right upgrades, and stay one step ahead of escalating threats.

Team up in 4-Player Co-op

Survive alone or join forces with up to three friends. Combine unique class abilities, synergize your defenses, and coordinate your roles for maximum efficiency. Whether you're mining, healing, powering defenses, or raining down artillery fire, teamwork is key to success.

A New Galaxy Every Run

Explore a procedurally generated galaxy filled with hostile planets, randomized planet traits, and escalating difficulty. Each planet offers new layouts, enemy mutations, and resource challenges that keep every run fresh and unpredictable. Will you pick the right path?

short_description: Build and defend your base to mine starlight crystals in this roguelike co-op tower defense! Carve paths, build defenses, and upgrade your operation as 1-4 players battle escalating waves of hostile threats across a procedurally generated galaxy.
